beats.say: Please Please Me spent over a full year in Britain's Top 10.
The Beatles recorded the album in one day at EMI Studios on 11 February 1963.
George Martin added overdubs to Misery and Baby It's You nine days later.
In 2012, it was voted 39th on Rolling Stone's top albums list.

facts: The album remained in the Top 10 for over a year in Britain.
The Beatles recorded Please Please Me in one day at EMI Studios on 11 February 1963.
George Martin added overdubs to Misery and Baby It's You nine days later.
Please Please Me was voted 39th on Rolling Stone's list of the 500 Greatest Albums of All Time in 2012.
